title: No Plastic Week
description: Avoid using plastic for one full week.

title: Plant a Tree
description: Plant at least one tree this week.

title: Participate in Cleanup Drive
description: Join a local cleanup drive this week.

title: Switch Off Lights
description: Practice energy saving by switching off lights when not in use throughout the week.

title: Use Public Transport
description: Commit to using public transport or carpooling at least 7 times this week.

title: Recycle Weekly Waste
description: Segregate and recycle household waste for the entire week.

title: Bike to Work
description: Use a bicycle for commuting at least 3 times this week.
